content:
name: Changeset

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "v[0-9]+"

jobs:
  create-release-pr:
    name: Create Changeset PR
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: yarn
      - name: Create Release Pull Request
        uses: changesets/action@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FRONTSIDEJACK_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
